purpose: Evidence-bound military education and authoritative information retrieval. The system supports human learning and information access; it does not self-authorize operational decisions.

tested_system_identity.rule: Any material change creates a different tested system and invalidates carry-forward performance evidence unless explicitly requalified.

principles: hard failures are conjunctive gates and cannot be compensated by mean accuracy
synthetic assurance is not production-domain evidence
outcome, transcript, harness, budget and environment are separately recorded
uncertainty is reported with confidence intervals rather than point estimates alone
offline knowledge must expose freshness and fail closed on signature, revocation or rollback failure
